name: libarchive
scope: entry name and decompressed entry bytes
family_note: Own ZIP reader and entry data API; DEFLATE uses compression support.

name: libzip
input_api: zip_open(const char*); zip_get_num_entries; zip_stat_index; zip_fopen_index and zip_fread
scope: entry name and decompressed entry bytes
family_note: Own ZIP archive reader and entry API.

name: minizip
scope: entry name and decompressed entry bytes
family_note: Classic MiniZip from the zlib contrib/minizip source subtree; separate from minizip-ng but related lineage.

name: minizip-ng
scope: entry name and decompressed entry bytes
family_note: Separate maintained package descended from classic MiniZip; not an independent family claim.

name: miniz
scope: entry name and decompressed entry bytes
family_note: miniz archive reader; its DEFLATE implementation is integrated.

name: libgsf
scope: entry name and decompressed entry bytes
family_note: Own ZIP directory and entry API; uses compression dependencies for DEFLATE.

name: kuba-zip
input_api: zip_open(const char*, int, char); zip_entries_total; zip_entry_openbyindex; zip_entry_name; zip_entry_read
scope: entry name and decompressed entry bytes
family_note: Distinct package API that embeds miniz for ZIP parsing and DEFLATE; shares underlying parser lineage with miniz.

name: zziplib
scope: entry name and decompressed entry bytes
family_note: Own ZIP archive reader; uses zlib for DEFLATE.

name: unarr
input_api: ar_open_file(const char*); ar_open_zip_archive; ar_parse_entry; ar_entry_get_name; ar_entry_uncompress
scope: entry name and decompressed entry bytes
family_note: selmf/unarr fork of zeniko/unarr; its ZIP parser and decompression API are part of the pinned source package.

name: physfs
input_api: PHYSFS_mount(local ZIP path); PHYSFS_enumerateFiles; PHYSFS_openRead; PHYSFS_readBytes
scope: mounted ZIP entry name and decompressed entry bytes
family_note: PhysicsFS provides a distinct virtual filesystem package API with an internal ZIP archive handler; its C++ call site reuses this C library.

name: lowzip
input_api: lowzip_init_archive with read_callback over local ZIP bytes; lowzip_locate_file; lowzip_get_data
scope: entry name and decompressed entry bytes
family_note: Independent footprint-optimized ZIP reader with built-in DEFLATE; the C++ path compiles the same source and C API.

name: unziplib
input_api: unzOpen(local ZIP bytes, ZIPFILE); unzGetGlobalInfo; unzGetCurrentFileInfo; unzReadCurrentFile
scope: entry name and decompressed entry bytes
family_note: Distinct 1.0.0 package with C callback/memory API and bundled zlib; its unzip.h credits Gilles Vollant and shares classic MiniZip lineage. Package license is Apache-2.0 with zlib-licensed bundled code.

name: libc7zip
license_note: Wrapper MIT; vendored lib7zip MPL-2.0; bundled 7-Zip engine LGPL 2.1 with project-noted additional terms dependent on build.
input_api: in_stream_new with local FILE read/seek callbacks; archive_open; archive_get_item_count; item_get_string_property(kpidPath); archive_extract_item to output callback
scope: entry name and decompressed entry bytes
family_note: Tagged MIT C facade vendors an MPL-2.0 lib7zip fork and loads a 7-Zip 26.03 engine; a distinct package path sharing the 7-Zip parser family with bit7z in C++.

name: infozip-unzip
input_api: UzpAltMain on a local ZIP path with listing callback; UzpUnzipToMemory(local ZIP path, parsed entry name); UzpFreeMemBuffer
scope: entry name parsed by Info-ZIP listing and decompressed entry bytes from its C API
family_note: Official Info-ZIP UnZip 6.0 source exposes a C DLL API. This path compiles its library objects and calls the API directly; it is separate from MiniZip, unzipLIB, and other ZIP engines.
